name: ZeroRF
definition: ZeroRF is a per-scene optimization method for sparse view 36° reconstruction that integrates a tailored Deep Image Prior into a factorized NeRF representation (specifically TensoRF-VM). It parametrizes feature grids with a neural network generator to keep features clean under sparse supervision, eliminating the need for pretraining or additional regularization.
summary: ZeroRF is a per-scene optimization method for sparse-view 360-degree reconstruction that uses untrained deep generator networks to create factorized NeRF representations, avoiding data bias and resolution limits.
